descriptionChirho: Adverbial and adjectival use meaning 'continually, constantly, at all times, perpetually,' modifying verbs or nouns to express unceasing duration or regularity.

Substantival use with the article (הַתָּמִיד) as a technical cultic term for the continual/daily burnt offering prescribed in the Torah (Num 28:6), and in Daniel for the regular temple sacrifice whose cessation signals desecration.
